summary: Alvotech furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 6, 2026 press release announcing a long-term strategic manufacturing partnership with LOTTE Biologics. LOTTE will produce drug substance for multiple antibody biosimilars at its Syracuse, New York facility, which holds 40,000 liters of bioreactor capacity and recently cleared an FDA inspection with zero observations. No financial terms, equity stake, pricing, or board recommendation were disclosed. The arrangement expands Alvotech's US manufacturing footprint and global supply capacity, complementing in-house and partner production. This is an ordinary commercial supply agreement, not a special situation; monitor capacity ramp and product allocation as operational milestones.
